name: Microsoft 365 sign-in (awareness-safe)
description: Awareness-training M365 sign-in: records only the submission FACT (page + submitted:true + timestamp), discards the password value before any transmission, and redirects to a built-in microlearning page (learn.html) after 300 ms. Use for security-awareness engagements where credentials must never be captured or stored.
placeholder_notes: No password is ever transmitted or stored. learn.html ships with the clone — swap the 2-min video placeholder for your real microlearning video before the wave. Replace branding/copy to match the target tenant if needed.
